title: ssh decryption and dissection: Changing architecture.
description:
Prepares the code for easier handling of additional crypto algorithms, to support sub-dissectors (e.g. sftp) and fragmented packet reassembly.

Changes handling of key file for ssh decryption.  
Adds debug logging facilities.  
Adds the ability to store the secret inside a DSB.  
Displays decrypted data for ECDH25519 / CHACHA20 combination of crypto algorithms.

This particular DSB secrets type does not seem to be mentioned in the [pcapng RFC draft](https://github.com/IETF-OPSAWG-WG/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcap). @Jerome-PS, did you just pick a random number? Can you describe the format and submit it there, similar to the changes for the OPC UA secrets type? https://github.com/IETF-OPSAWG-WG/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcap/commits/master/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcapng.md

Hi John,

I don’t think I was aware of the fact that DSB types were registered in the pcapng RFC.
What I did was use the same pattern as TLS (ASCII for TLSK, I chose SSHK).
I’ll try submit an update to the RFC.

Cheers,
Jerome.
